reviews.title: Now rubbish
reviews.text: What was once a superb app that gave information clearly and accurately has developed into a complete pile of garbage. Constant intrusive advertising for American companies and products. Not relevant here. Keeps requesting to use location when custom location is set. Sorry you have destroyed a once useful app. Erased from my phone.
